response.sql: WITH matched_data AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), trans_trader_counts AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) as row_count FROM matched_data GROUP BY transreg, tradekind), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(row_count) as total FROM trans_trader_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT ttc.transreg, ttc.tradekind, ttc.row_count, CAST(ttc.row_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share FROM trans_trader_counts ttc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), trader_stats AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(row_count) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_count, avg_share FROM trader_stats
